overall_goal: Prepare, knead, and set the dough to rest for Lebanese meat pies

goals.description: Prepare ingredients and combine wet and dry components
goals.rationale: The person organizes the ingredients on the counter and pours oil and the yeast mixture into the flour to start making the dough.

goals.description: Mix and knead the dough while adjusting hydration
goals.rationale: The person mixes the ingredients with a spoon and by hand, adding water as needed to achieve the right dough consistency.

goals.description: Add flour to adjust dough consistency and continue kneading
goals.rationale: The person adds a handful of flour to reduce the dough's wetness and kneads it thoroughly while scraping stuck dough off their hands.

goals.description: Clean and dry a smaller bowl for proofing
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a smaller bowl, empties it, rinses it under the tap, and dries it with a towel to prepare it for the dough.

goals.description: Oil the bowl and transfer the dough into it
goals.rationale: The person coats the inside of the clean bowl with oil, transfers the dough into it, and oils the surface of the dough to prevent sticking.

goals.description: Cover the dough and place it in the oven to rest
goals.rationale: The person covers the bowl with towels and places it inside the switched-off oven to provide a warm environment for proofing.
